Author: Surlako
Name: Lightless Auto Pair
Punchline: Automatically sends pairing requests to nearby Lightfinder users with safeguards.
Description: A companion for Lightless Sync that can automatically contact nearby Lightfinder broadcasters. Includes a master toggle, a 3–30 second delay, persistent decline blacklist, pending/paired protection, status log, and automatic pause while Lightless is disconnected. Use /lightautopair for settings.
